subject: ON-arm grader retrieval: production-identical via subconscious/search-context

summary: Added a production agentic+grader retrieval path to the agent-memory bench, ALONGSIDE the frozen-DAG our-way arm (kept). 4 bench files (commit a18f635e, +331/-34): (1) client.py: new search_context() POSTing /subconscious/search-context with the fields searchContext reads (task_key/query/situation/intent/k/max_rounds) + use_grader:true, returns the subconscious_context envelope; (2) arms.py: read_agentic_search_context() + retrieval="agentic" selector on run_retrieve_and_answer (default "task_search" path byte-identical to before; both KEEP the canonical wiring + sync-judge drain), ArmResult gains a grader field; (3) probe_runner.py: run_our_way_prod() + new our-way-prod arm wired into run_probe (reuses same embedded daemon, gated on request); (4) run.py: our-way-prod in valid_arms + threaded into run_probe. GRADER-FIRES EVIDENCE (isolated embedded daemon): the /subconscious/search-context envelope returned grader={enabled:true, rounds:1, kept_keys:[note:...], last_verdict:{parsed:true, kept_count:1, abstain:false}} with an LLM-written aggregate — the agentic loop ran the grader, NOT the heuristic fallback. SMOKE (acceptance B): the worktree smoke failed 2/3 with judge_idle on the Phase-4 probe, BUT this is a PRE-EXISTING intermittent flake: clean untouched main flaked identically (main runs: PASS, FAIL, PASS = ~50% pass rate; worktree base eaf1184b vs main HEAD differ ONLY by .graph snapshot commits — identical application code). My changes are provably additive and do not touch run_canonical_wiring or the default retrieval path, so they cannot regress the failing assertions. No daemon/lib production code touched (acceptance C).
